issues.problem: The condition u ≠ 0 is not stated for the projection formula proj = |u·v| / |u|.
issues.fix: Add a brief note that u must be non-zero for the projection formula to be defined.

factErrors: Projection beat and hint: the construction of the line of u and the formula |u·v|/|u| require u≠0, but this condition is omitted even though the clip says Cauchy–Schwarz holds for all vectors; u=0 must be handled separately.

Inequality beat: for the perpendicular and parallel/antiparallel presets, the claimed right triangle is degenerate because one of its perpendicular legs has length 0, so it is not a genuine right triangle with projection as a leg and v as a hypotenuse; a genuine right-triangle leg is strictly shorter.

Equality caption and after-line: “u∥v ⇔ equality” omits the zero-vector cases. For arbitrary vectors, equality is equivalent to linear dependence; when both vectors are nonzero, this is equivalent to being parallel, including opposite directions. The determinant condition uₓvᵧ−uᵧvₓ=0 itself is correct.

Projection misconception: the sign of u·v determines the projection's direction only when u·v≠0 and only relative to u. In the perpendicular preset u·v=0 and the projection has zero length, so it has no positive or negative direction.

Final equality frame: the generic preset remains u=(3,1), v=(1,2), with determinant 5 and projection 1.581, yet the chapter says that v is turned until parallel to u. The parallel and opposite presets already begin parallel, so the stated gradual turn is also inaccurate.

issues.problem: The universal scope is implicit even though the animation uses concrete preset pairs.
issues.fix: State that u and v are arbitrary nonzero real vectors, handle a zero vector separately, and make clear whether the animation is a general construction or only an intuition.

issues.problem: The narration never substitutes the displayed coordinates or computes any of dot, normU, normV, or proj numerically.
issues.fix: Include at least one full numerical calculation in each preset, such as 3·1+1·2=5 and 5/√10≈1.581.

issues.problem: The clip asserts the equality condition without deriving why no nonparallel configuration can give equality.
issues.fix: Introduce the perpendicular residual d and use |v|²=proj²+d²; then equality is equivalent to d=0, hence to linear dependence.

issues.problem: Absolute cosine and “cross product” appear without being defined for the coordinate representation.
issues.fix: Define the cosine relation for nonzero vectors and call uₓvᵧ−uᵧvₓ the determinant or z-component of the two-dimensional cross product.
